incidents.title: P1 — ADJUD-MAIN ABEND at 02:14 — batch window breach
incidents.description: MADJDRV0 ABENDed with S0C7 (data exception) at step 3 of ADJUD-MAIN job stream. Root cause: ACCUM-FILE record for member MBR-77823 had corrupted packed decimal field in family OOP accumulator. Batch window breached by 2h47m. 847,000 claims not adjudicated in nightly window.
incidents.root_cause: Corrupted COMP-3 packed decimal in ACCUM-FILE family OOP max field. Member retroactive enrollment change on 2026-08-04 caused partial write to ACCUM-FILE that left packed decimal in invalid state.
incidents.resolution: James Whitfield identified corrupted record via XPEDITER. Manual IDCAMS REPRO to fix ACCUM-FILE record. Restarted ADJUD-MAIN from checkpoint. Claims processed by 06:30.

incidents.title: P2 — PROV-MSTR VSAM not refreshed — MiProvider feed 3 hours late
incidents.description: MiProvider nightly feed arrived 3 hours late due to SQL Server maintenance window overrun. PROV-MSTR VSAM not refreshed before morning batch. 1,247 provider records stale. Claims for newly terminated providers processed with stale network status.
incidents.root_cause: SQL Server maintenance window for MiProvider database ran 3 hours over schedule. No automated alert configured for feed SLA breach. Operations team discovered issue manually at 07:45.
incidents.resolution: Delayed morning intraday batch by 90 minutes. MiProvider feed completed. PROV-MSTR refreshed. Affected claims reprocessed.

incidents.title: P2 — S3 CLAIMS-FULL feed missing — analytics team blocked
incidents.description: CLAIMS-FULL S3 feed not landed in s3://mivan-datalake/raw/claims/daily/ by 08:00 SLA. Analytics team unable to run daily reports. Snowflake refresh blocked. Modernization team ETL pipeline failed.
incidents.root_cause: FEED-OUTBOUND JCL job ABEND on SFTP transfer step. EBCDIC-to-ASCII conversion utility ran out of disk space on mainframe staging DASD. JCL condition code check missed because utility writes RC=0 even on partial failure.
incidents.resolution: Cleared staging DASD. Reran FEED-OUTBOUND from SFTP step. S3 feed landed by 11:00. Analytics team unblocked. Added disk space monitoring alert.

incidents.title: P3 — COB calculation wrong for dual-eligible member — overpayment identified
incidents.description: Post-payment audit identified COB calculation error for 23 dual-eligible Medicare/commercial members. MCOBPYR0 applied wrong COB method — used Standard COB instead of Medicare Secondary Payer rules. Overpayment of $47,230 identified.
incidents.root_cause: Medicare Advantage payer ID added in 2024 not in PAYER_COB_AGREE DB2 table. MCOBPYR0 fell through to hardcoded COBOL EVALUATE which applied Standard COB instead of MSP rules for this payer.
incidents.resolution: Added payer ID to PAYER_COB_AGREE table. Reprocessed 23 claims. Demand letters issued for $47,230 overpayment recovery.

change_requests.title: Annual DRG rate table update — CMS FY2027 rates
change_requests.description: Annual CMS MS-DRG relative weight update for FY2027. Runs MDRGLDS0 job to load new DRG-RATES RRDS. Requires batch window exclusion. All institutional inpatient claims will use new rates from 2026-10-01.
change_requests.risk: High — incorrect DRG rates will cause widespread institutional claim mispricing
change_requests.rollback_plan: Reload prior year DRG-RATES RRDS from backup. Reprocess institutional claims from cutover date.

change_requests.title: NCCI quarterly edit table update — Q3 2026
change_requests.description: Quarterly CMS NCCI edit table update. Runs MNCCILD0 to load new NCCI-TABLE KSDS. 47 new PTP edit pairs added. 12 existing pairs modified.
change_requests.risk: Medium — incorrect edits will cause incorrect claim denials or approvals

problem_records.title: Recurring ACCUM-FILE corruption pattern — 3 incidents in 6 months
problem_records.description: Three separate incidents in the last 6 months involving ACCUM-FILE packed decimal corruption. Root cause not yet identified. Suspected issue with MACCUPD0 checkpoint logic during concurrent CICS/batch access.
problem_records.hypothesis: CICS transactions reading ACCUM-FILE during batch update window may cause partial writes when CICS quiesce does not complete cleanly. Undocumented ACCUM-FILE record layout makes diagnosis difficult.
